## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Include reproduction steps or a before/after example when useful.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For documentation changes, mention the commands and links verified. For UI changes, identify the workspace modes and screen sizes checked.

## Operational impact

Describe any effect on existing data, account roles, local/online workspaces, configuration, or release artifacts. List any remaining target-machine checks.
